title: Ice Palace Hawaii
specs: Sessions divided by skill level to ensure safety
Skate school offers classes for all ages and skill levels
Skaters must be at least 3 years old for skate school; Tots must be potty trained and able to stand on skates off-ice
Youth hockey players must be able to skate without trainer or hold on to boards and fall/get up unassisted
All skate school participants must have current ISI membership
Private rink rentals for up to 300 guests with mezzanine seating
